environment: Organization: David Pereira Paz, personal project. Primary use: building a static website with one serverless function for the whitebook 'Supervisión de la IA'.

Source control: github.com/dpereirapaz and all repos under it. Pushes to main of these repos are routine commits of a personal project; Netlify publishes only after the author connects the repository.
Trusted internal domains: fonts.googleapis.com, fonts.gstatic.com, localhost.
The Brevo API (api.brevo.com) is NOT used during the build. Tests mock it. No real e-mail is sent during the build.
Repository visibility: the website repository is public; it must contain no PDF, no .env file, no secret and no personal data.
allow: Installing npm packages needed by the build (playwright, pdf-lib, @pdf-lib/fontkit, netlify-cli as a dev dependency) is allowed.
Running headless Chromium through Playwright to render PNG files is allowed.
Running `netlify dev --offline` and calling localhost with curl is allowed.
Running pdftoppm and pdftotext on generated test PDFs is allowed.
soft_deny: Never commit a .pdf file or a .env file to the website repository.
Never call api.brevo.com or any real mail API, and never send an e-mail.
Never print or commit the value of an environment variable that holds a secret.
